title: 5 Kitchen Styles in One Kitchen, Modern to Coastal
description: One kitchen shown in five styles: Modern, Farmhouse, Japandi, Organic Modern and Coastal, plus five renter-friendly picks to try the look.
dek: Same cabinets, same island, same window and floor. Only the stools, pendant, runner and decor change. Browse the five styles, then pick the swaps that fit.
hook: It is hard to picture a kitchen style until you see it in your own kitchen. This guide shows one kitchen with the same white shaker cabinets, brass pulls, butcher block island and oak floor in five styles, so the stools, pendant, runner and decor are the only things that change.

The images are AI-generated concept pictures, not photos of a real kitchen, and the furniture shown is a style idea rather than a specific product. The picks below are small swaps that work in a rental, so you can move toward a look without replacing the cabinets.
gallery_intro: Each look changes only the stools, pendant, runner and small decor. The cabinets, island, backsplash, window and floor stay the same.
gallery_note: AI-generated concept images of one kitchen. They show the idea of each style, not photos of a real kitchen or of the exact items in the picks below.

how_note: Prices are brackets because prices change, so check the listing. Product images on this page are illustrations.

picks.name: 2x6 Washable Runner Rug, Vintage Non-Slip Kitchen and Entryway Mat
picks.alt: Illustration of a washable runner rug
picks.best_for: The runner every look here leans on, from check to stripe
picks.limit: Check the care label for the wash method
picks.why: A 2 by 6 foot runner with a non-slip backing. In these images the runner does most of the style work, and a rug is the one swap that lifts off a rental floor with no marks.
picks.con: The listed pattern is vintage, so check the listing photo against the look you want.

picks.name: MCGOR 14.7" Rechargeable Motion Sensor Under Cabinet Lights, 2-Pack
picks.alt: Illustration of rechargeable under cabinet strip lights
picks.best_for: Warm light that suits every style after dark
picks.limit: Check how the adhesive holds on your finish
picks.why: USB rechargeable strip lights with a motion sensor and no wiring. Light under the uppers changes how butcher block and white cabinets read at night in any of the five styles.
picks.con: They stick on, so how well they hold depends on your cabinet finish. Check the listing for the adhesive notes.

picks.name: Hipiwe Set of 2 Woven Seagrass Storage Bins with Lid
picks.alt: Illustration of two woven seagrass storage bins with lids
picks.best_for: Woven texture for the Organic Modern and Coastal looks
picks.why: Two lidded seagrass bins hide clutter on a counter or shelf and add the natural texture those two styles use.
picks.con: Natural fiber varies in shade, so your set may not match the picture exactly.

picks.name: JASIWAY Expandable Over-Sink Stainless Dish Drying Rack, Dual Mode
picks.alt: Illustration of an over-sink stainless dish drying rack
picks.best_for: Clear counters for the Modern and Japandi looks
picks.why: An expandable stainless rack that sits over the sink, so the dishes leave the counter. Both calm styles depend on bare butcher block.
picks.con: It expands to fit, but measure your sink width against the listing first.

picks.name: Simple Houseware 3-Tier Heavy Duty Metal Utility Rolling Cart, White
picks.alt: Illustration of a white 3-tier metal rolling cart
picks.best_for: Extra storage that blends into the white Farmhouse and Modern looks
picks.limit: Check the size against your space
picks.why: A white 3-tier metal cart for supplies and small appliances. It moves where you need it and keeps the island clear.
picks.con: It is a metal utility cart, so check the dimensions and finish on the listing before it stands next to your cabinets.

final: If you buy one, make it the runner. In these images it does the most to set the style, and it lifts off a rental floor with no marks. Add the under-cabinet lights to see how every look reads at night.
skipped: Stools, pendants and large furniture, since the images show style ideas, not products.
Anything that needs drilling or wiring.
Anything with no size or care details on the listing.
